newsitem.title: UK: UK shares firmer in early trading, awaiting FOMC.
newsitem.headline: UK shares firmer in early trading, awaiting FOMC.

text.p: UK shares rose in early trading on Tuesday, buoyed by firm index futures and gilt markets, although dealings are expected to remain subdued as the market awaits the outcome of UK and U.S. monetary meetings, traders said.
The Federal Open Market Committee, the policy-making arm of the Federal Reserve, begins its two-day meeting today. UK monetary authorities meet for their regular meeting tomorrow.

"Recent figures show there's really no threat of inflation heating up, so there's no reason to raise rates, but I would have thought the market needs to get these meetings out of the way," said one dealer.
